verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              ब्रूहि भूयो महाबुद्धे धर्मार्थसहितं वचः। शृण्वतो नास्ति मे तृप्तिर्विचित्राणीह भाषसे ॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said O you of great wisdom, repeat these sayings, that are consist on with morality and worldly benefit. What you say is most interesting; my desire for hearing them has not been satisfied.
verses.bhavadeepa: अनुक्रोशात् दयालुत्वात् आनृशंस्यात् अक्रौर्यात् ॥८६॥

verses.sanskrit:
विदुर उवाच।
              सर्वतीर्थेषु वा स्नानं सर्वभूतेषु चार्जवम्। उभे त्वेते समे स्यातामार्जवं वा विशिष्यते ॥२॥
verses.english: Vidura said Bathing in all the holy places and kindness to all beings-both these are equal. Perhaps kindness is better.
verses.bhavadeepa: ब्रहीति ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: आर्जवं प्रतिपद्यस्व पुत्रेषु सततं विभो। इह कीर्तिं परां प्राप्य प्रेत्य स्वर्गमवाप्स्यसि ॥३॥
verses.english: O Lord, always show kindness to your sons; and thus you will attain to heaven after having gained great fame in this world.
verses.bhavadeepa: आर्जवमवषैम्यम् ॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: यावत् कीर्तिर्मनुष्यस्य पुण्या लोके प्रगीयते। तावत्स पुरुषव्याघ्र स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥४॥
verses.english: As long as a man's deeds are spoken of in this world, so long, O foremost among men, he is glorious in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। विरोचनस्य संवादं केशिन्यर्थे सुधन्वना ॥५॥
verses.english: As an instance of this is cited the old story about the conversation between Virochana and Sudhanvan, suitors of Keshini's hand.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयंवरे स्थिता कन्या केशिनी नाम नामतः। रूपेणाप्रतिमा राजन् विशिष्टपतिकाम्यया॥६॥
verses.english: A maiden named Keshini, of peerless beauty, o king, with the desire of a good husband, resolved to to choose in Svayamvara.

verses.sanskrit: विरोचनोऽथ दैतेयस्तदा तत्राजगाम ह। प्राप्तुमिच्छंस्ततस्तत्र दैत्येन्द्रं प्राह केशिनी॥७॥
verses.english: Then Virochana, a son of Diti, came there with the desire of winning her. Then did Keshini address that chief among the Daityas thus. one a

verses.sanskrit: केशिन्युवाच। किं ब्राह्मणाः स्विच्छ्रेयांसो दितिजाः स्विद्विरोचन। अथ केन स्म पर्यङ्कं सुधन्वा नाधिरोहति ॥८॥
verses.english: Keshini said Are the Brahmanas superior or are the sons of Diti superior, O Virochana? why should not Sudhanvan sit on the sofa?

verses.sanskrit:
विरोचन उवाच।
              प्राजापत्यास्तु वै श्रेष्ठा वयं केशिनि सत्तमाः। अस्माकं खल्विमे लोकाः के देवाः के द्विजातयः ॥९॥
verses.english: Virochana said We, the descendants of Prajapati, O Keshini, are the best among creatures. This world is ours. Who are the gods and who are the twice-born person?
verses.bhavadeepa: सुधन्वा ब्राह्मणः पर्यङ्कमधिरोहत्येव त्वं तु नीचो दैत्यः सन्ः किमर्थं तत्प्रत्याख्यानं करोषीति भावः॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: केशिन्युवाच। इहैवावां प्रतीक्षाव उपस्थाने विरोचन। सुधन्वा प्रातरागन्ता पश्येयं वां समागतौ ॥१०॥
verses.english: Keshini said Even in this very Pavilion shall we wait, O Virochana. Sudhanvan will come in the morning to-morrow; I shall both of you together.

verses.sanskrit:
विरोचन उवाच।
              तथा भद्रे करिष्यामि यथा त्वं भीरु भाषसे। सुधन्वानं च मां चैव प्रातर्द्रष्टाऽसि सङ्गतौ ॥११॥
verses.english: Virochana said 0gentle maiden, I shall do as you say, 0 timid one; you will see in the morning myself and Sudhanvan together.
verses.bhavadeepa: इह स्थाने उपस्थाने मामुपस्थातुं वां दैत्यब्राह्मणौ अहं पश्येयम् ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit:
विदुर उवाच।
              अतीतायां च शर्वर्यामुदिते सूर्यमण्डले। अथाजगाम तं देशं सुधन्वा राजसत्तम। विरोचनो यत्र विभो केशिन्या सहितः स्थितः। सुधन्वा च समागच्छत् प्राह्लादिं केशिनीं तथा॥१२॥
verses.english: Vidura said The night had passed away and the solar disc had appeared, there came to that country, O best kings, Sudhanvan, where, O Lord, Virochana was staying with Keshini.

verses.sanskrit: समागतं द्विजं दृष्ट्वा केशिनी भरतर्षभ। प्रत्युत्थायासनं तस्मै पाद्यमर्घ्यं ददौ पुनः॥१३॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan came to the son of Prahrada and Keshini; the latter, O best among the race if Bharata, having observed the approach of a Brahmana, rose up; and gave him water to wash his feet and the Arghya (mark of respect).

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वोवाच। अन्वालभे हिरण्मयं प्राह्लादे ते वरासनम्। एकत्वमुपसम्पन्नो न त्वासेऽहं त्वया सह ॥१४॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan said (When asked by Virochana to sit on the sofa he occupied) O son of Prahrada, how can I touch that excellent gold seat occupied by you? I shall then come down to the same level with yourself. I shall not sit with you.
verses.bhavadeepa: समागच्छत् उभयोः संमुखमगच्छत् । समागतं संमुखं प्राप्तम् ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit:
विरोचन उवाच।
              तवार्हते तु फलकं कूर्चं वाऽप्यथवा बृसी। सुधन्वन्न त्वमर्होऽसि मया सह समासनम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Virochana said You are fit for (sitting on) a plank, a skin or a mat. O Sudhanvan, you are not fit for a seat equal to mine.
verses.bhavadeepa: विरोचनेन सौवर्णे पीठे मया सह उपवेश्यतामिति प्रार्थितः सुधन्वा उवाच । अन्वालभे स्पृशाम्येव हे प्रह्रादे एकत्वं त्वया सह साम्यम् उपसंपन्नश्चेत् भवेदहं गच्छेयमिति शेषः । न तु त्वया सह एकासने आसे उपविशामि ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वोवाच। पितापुत्रौ सहासीतां द्वौ विप्रौ क्षत्रियावपि। वृद्धौ वैश्यौ च शूद्रौ च न त्वन्याविरतेतरम्॥१६॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan said Father and son, two Brahmanas, two Kshatriyas, two old men and two Sudras can sit together. Excepting these, no others can sit together.
verses.bhavadeepa: फलकं काष्ठपीठं कूर्चं वृसीं वर्तितदर्भमयं पीठं वा तव अर्हते योग्यं भवति ॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: पिता हि ते समासीनमुपासीतैव मामधः। बालः सुखैधितो गेहे न त्वं किञ्चन बुध्यसे ॥१७॥
verses.english: Your father used to respect me and occupy a seat lower than mine. You are a child bred in luxury at home; and do not know anything.

verses.sanskrit:
विरोचन उवाच।
              हिरण्यं च गवाश्वं च यद्वित्तमसुरेषु नः। सुधन्वन् विपणेतेन प्रश्नं पृच्छाव ये विदुः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Virochana said The gold kine, horses and all other wealth that we Asuras have-staking all these, o Sudhanvan, let us ask this question to them that know.
verses.bhavadeepa: उपासीत सेवते अधःस्थित्वेति शेषः ॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वोवाच। हिरण्यं च गवाश्वं च तवैवास्तु विरोचन। प्राणयोस्तु पणं कृत्वा प्रश्नं पृच्छाव ये विदुः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan said O Virochana, let alone your gold, kine and horses. Let us stake our very lives and ask them the question that are able to answer.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रश्नम् आवयोः कः श्रेष्ठ इति प्रश्नं ये विदुस्तान् पृच्छाव ॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit:
विरोचन उवाच।
              आवां कुत्र गमिष्यावः प्राणयोर्विपणे कृते। न हि देवेष्वहं स्थाता न मनुष्येषु कर्हिचित् ॥२०॥
verses.english: Virochana said Where shall we go after staking our lives. I shall not stand before any of the gods and never before any among men.

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वोवाच। पितरं ते गमिष्यावः प्राणयोर्विपणे कृते। पुत्रस्यापि स हेतोर्हि प्रह्लादो नानृतं वदेत् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan said We shall go your father after staking our lives. Prahrada will not tell a lie even for the sake of his son.

verses.sanskrit:
विदुर उवाच।
              एवं कृतपणौ क्रुद्धौ तत्राभिजग्मतुस्तदा। विरोचनसुधन्वानौ प्रह्लादो यत्र तिष्ठति॥२२॥
verses.english: Vidura said In this way having laid wagers, Virochana and Sudhanvan, enraged at each other, then went to the place where Prahrada was staying.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लाद उवाच।
              इमौ तौ सम्प्रदृश्येते याभ्यां न चरितं सह। आशीविषाविव क्रुद्धावेकमार्गविहागतौ ॥२३॥
verses.english: Prahrada said These two now appear, who have never before been together, like two enraged serpents coming by the same road.

verses.sanskrit: किं वै सहैवं चरथो न पुरा चरतः सह। विरोचनैतत् पृच्छामि किं ते सख्यं सुधन्वना ॥२४॥
verses.english: Is it that friendship has now been established between you, among whom these was no friendship before? O Virochana, I ask you why this friendship with Sudhanvan.
verses.bhavadeepa: सह न चरितं वैरात् ॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit:
विरोचन उवाच।
              न मे सुधन्वना सख्यं प्राणयोर्विपणावहे। प्रह्लाद तत्त्वं पृच्छामि मा प्रश्नमनृतं वदेः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Virochana said There is no friendship between myself and Sudhanvan. (the Truth is that) we have wagered our lives. O sire, I shall ask you a question; do not answer it untruely.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लाद उवाच।
              उदकं मधुपर्कं वाऽप्यानयन्तु सुधन्वने। ब्रह्मन्नभ्यर्चनीयोऽसि श्वेता गौः पीवरीकृता ॥२६॥
verses.english: Prahrada said Let water, honey and curds be brought for Sudhanvan. O Brahmana, you ought to be respected by ine. A white and healthy cow is ready for you.

verses.sanskrit:
सुधन्वोवाच।
              उदकं मधुपर्कं च पथिष्वेवार्पितं मम। प्रह्लाद त्वं तु मे तथ्यं प्रश्नं प्रब्रूहि पृच्छतोः॥ किं ब्राह्मणाः स्विच्छ्रेयांस उताहोस्विद्विरोचनः॥२७॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan said Water, honey and curds have been presented to me on the way. O Prahrada, I ask you a question; answer truly what I ask you. Are the Brahmanas superior or is Virochana superior?
verses.bhavadeepa: पीवरी पुष्टा कृता मधुपर्कार्थम् उपकल्पिता ॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लाद उवाच।
              पुत्र एको मम ब्रह्मंस्त्वं च साक्षादिहास्थितः। तयोर्विवदतोः प्रश्नं कथमस्मद्विधो वदेत् ॥२८॥
verses.english: Prahrada said I have got only one son; and you are a Brahmana present here in person. How can one situated as I am, answer the question, which is a matter of dispute between yourselves.
verses.bhavadeepa: पथिष्विति प्रश्ननिर्णयेनैतत्प्राप्तमिति भावः ॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वोवाच। गां प्रदद्यास्त्वौरसाय यद्वाऽन्यत्स्यात् प्रियं धनम्। द्वयोर्विवदतोस्तथ्यं वाच्यं च मतिमंस्त्वया॥२९॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan said Keep your cow and whatever wealth you hold dear for yourself; but, O wise man, you should speak the truth in a matter, on which we two are disputing.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लाद उवाच।
              अथ यो नैव प्रब्रूयात्सत्यं वा यदि वाऽनृतम्। एतत्सुधन्वन् पृच्छामि दुर्विवक्ता स्म किं वसेत् ॥३०॥
verses.english: Prahrada said Who does not answer, truly or falsely; I ask you, Sudhanvan, where does that wrong user of his tongue live?

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वोवाच। यां रात्रिमधिविन्ना स्त्री यां चैवाक्षपराजितः। यां च भाराभितप्ताङ्गो दुर्विवक्ता स्म तां वसेत् ॥३१॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan said One who makes a wrong use of his tongue lives passing his nights like a woman having her husband sleeping in the arms of a co-wife or like one who has been defeated at a game at dice or like one whose body is burning with troubles.
verses.bhavadeepa: दुर्विवक्ता दुष्टविवेककर्ता अन्याय्यवक्तेत्यर्थः । किं वसेत् किं दुःखं प्राप्नुयात् ॥३०॥

verses.sanskrit: नगरे प्रतिरुद्धः सन् बहिर्द्वारे बुभुक्षितः। अमित्रान् भूयसः पश्येद्यः साक्ष्यमनृतं वदेत् ॥३२॥
verses.english: The man, who is giving evidence tells lies, stays staving at the outer gates, shut out from the city; and he always sees his enemies.
verses.bhavadeepa: अधिविन्ना कृतसपत्नीका स्त्री तां रात्रिं वसेत्तद्वद्दुःखं प्राप्नुयात् ॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च पश्वनृते हन्ति दश हन्ति गवानृते। शतमश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं पुरुषानृते ॥३३॥
verses.english: A lie for the sake of an animal means the degradation from heaven of five of one's ancestors; one for the sake of a cow means the downfall of ten; one for the sake of a horse means for the downfall of a hundred; while one for the sake of a man means the casting away of a thousand.
verses.bhavadeepa: नगरे इति शरणमलभमानः क्षुधार्तः शत्रुभिर्वेष्टितश्च यत् दुःखं लभते सः अनृतसाक्ष्यवक्ताऽपि लभेतेत्यर्थः ॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: हन्ति जातानजातांश्च हिरण्यार्थेऽनृतं वदन्। सर्वं भूम्यनृते हन्ति मा स्म भूम्यनृतं वदेः ॥३४॥
verses.english: A lie for the sake of gold means the destruction of one's race born and unborn; and one for the sake of land means the ruin of everything. Therefore do not tell lies for the sake of land.
verses.bhavadeepa: पञ्च पूर्वजान् पश्वनृते अजादिपश्वर्थमनृते उक्ते सति हन्ति नाशयति परलोकात् च्यावयति एवमुत्तरत्र॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit:
प्रह्लाद उवाच।
              मत्तः श्रेयानङ्गिरा वै सुधन्वा त्वद्विरोचन। माताऽस्य श्रेयसी मातुस्तस्मात्त्वं तेन वै जितः ॥३५॥
verses.english: Prahrada said Superior to me is Angirasa; and superior to you is Sudhanvan, O Virochana. His mother, too, is superior to (your) mother. Therefore you have been vanquished by him.
verses.bhavadeepa: भूमितुल्या केशिनी तदर्थमनृतं भूम्यनृतम् ॥३४॥

verses.sanskrit: विरोचन सुधन्वाऽयं प्राणानामीश्वरस्तव। सुधन्वन् पुनरिच्छामि त्वया दत्तं विरोचनम् ॥३६॥
verses.english: O Virochana, this Sudhanvan is now the lord of your life. O Sudhanvan, I desire it (the life) to be restored by you to Virochana.
verses.bhavadeepa: अङ्गिराः सुधन्वनः पिता त्वत् त्वत्तः ॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वोवाच। यद्धर्ममवृणीथास्त्वं न कामादनृतं वदीः। पुनर्ददामि ते पुत्रं तस्मात् प्रह्लाद दुर्लभम् ॥३७॥
verses.english: Sudhanvan said you have chosen virtue and have not I spoken an untruth from temptation; therefore I give back your dear son his life, O Prahrada.

verses.sanskrit: एष प्रह्लाद पुत्रस्ते मया दत्तो विरोचनः। पादप्रक्षालनं कुर्यात् कुमार्याः संनिधौ मम ॥३८॥
verses.english: This son of your, Virochana, who is given to you by me, O Prahrada, should wash my feet before the maiden. Since you

verses.sanskrit:
विदुर उवाच।
              तस्माद्राजेन्द्र भूम्यर्थे नानृतं वक्तुमर्हसि। मा गमः ससुतामात्यो नाशं पुत्रार्थमब्रुवन् ॥३९॥
verses.english: Vidura said Therefore, O chief among kings you should not speak an untruth for the sake of land. Do not ruin yourself with your sons and ministers by refraining from speaking the truth.
verses.bhavadeepa: पादप्रक्षालनं हरिद्रया पादधावनं कुमार्याः केशिन्याः विवाहे दम्पत्योः परस्परं हरिद्रया पादधावनं कुर्वन्तीति प्रसिद्धम् । अस्यैव भार्या केशिनी भवत्वित्यर्थः ॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: न देवा यष्टिमादाय रक्षन्ति पशुपालवत्। यं तु रक्षितुमिच्छन्ति बुद्ध्या संविभजन्ति तम् ॥४०॥
verses.english: The gods do not look after men with club in hands, like the herdsman. To those they want to protect, they give intelligence.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रकृते आख्यायिकोपयोगमाह - तस्मादिति। अब्रुवन्सत्यमिति शेषः ॥३९॥

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा हि पुरुषः कल्याणे कुरुते मनः। तथा तथाऽस्य सर्वार्थाः सिद्ध्यन्ते नात्र संशयः ॥४१॥
verses.english: In proportion as a man is inclined towards virtue, his wishes meet with success, there is no doubt about it.
verses.bhavadeepa: तव दैवं प्रतिकूलम् अधीतं च निष्फलमित्याह त्रयेण - न देवा इति ॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit: नैनं छन्दांसि वृजिनात्तारयन्ति मायाविनं मायया वर्तमानम्। नीडं शकुन्ता इव जातपक्षाश्छन्दांस्येनं प्रजहत्यन्तकाले ॥४२॥
verses.english: The Vedas do not rescue one who is deceitful and lives by deceit from sins. Indeed, the Vedas, when the end approaches, forsake him, as the full-fledge birds forsake their nests.

verses.sanskrit: मद्यपानं कलहं पूगवैरं भार्यापत्योरन्तरं ज्ञातिभेदम्। राजद्विष्टं स्त्रीपुमांसोर्विवादं वर्ज्यान्याहुर्यश्च पन्थाः प्रदुष्टः ॥४३॥
verses.english: Drinking quarrels, enmity with many, separating husband from wife (by sowing dissensions), family quarrels, disloyalty to the king, causing quarrels between husbands and wife ought, it is said, to be avoided, as well as the sinful ways of life.

verses.sanskrit: सामुद्रिकं वणिजं चोरपूर्वं शलाकधूर्तं च चिकित्सकं च। अरिं च मित्रं च कुशीलवं च नैतान् साक्ष्ये त्वधिकुर्वीत सप्त ॥४४॥
verses.english: A palmist, a merchant who has formerly been a thief, a cunning fowler, a medical man, an enemy, a friend and one who is of bad habits these seven should not be cited as witnesses.
verses.bhavadeepa: अन्तरं वियोगं विवादं वैरप्रवर्तनं ज्ञातिभेदे कलहे च तव प्रवृत्तिर्न योग्येति भावः ॥४३॥

verses.sanskrit: मानाग्निहोत्रमुत मानमौनं मानेनाधीतमुत मानयज्ञः। एतानि चत्वार्यभयङ्कराणि भयं प्रयच्छन्त्ययथाकृतानि ॥४५॥
verses.english: An Agnihotra ceremony performed out of vanity, silence, study out of vanity and pride based upon haughtiness, these four though not fearful of themselves, become fearful when performed unduly.
verses.bhavadeepa: सामुद्रिकं हस्त रेखादिपरीक्षकं वणिजं चोरपूर्वं पूर्वं चोरः पश्चाद्वणिक्भूतः तं कूटतुलावन्तं वा शलाकया पाशादिना वा शकुनादिकमुक्त्वा योऽन्यान् वञ्चयति तमरिं विपरीतसाक्ष्यभयात् मित्रं परीक्षकाणामविश्वासात् कुशीलवं कुत्सितं शीलं वाति अनुसरतीति तं नर्तकीदासं विटोन्मत्तादिकं वा तव तु कूटद्यूतकारी शकुनिः कुशीलव एव प्रमाणम् ॥४४॥

verses.sanskrit: अगारदाही गरदः कुण्डाशी सोमविक्रयी। पर्वकारश्च सूची च मित्रध्रुक् पारदारिकः ॥४६॥
verses.english: 46-An incendiary, one who imprisons other persons, a pander, a wine-seller, a manufacturer of arrows, an astrologer, one who injuries friends, one who violates other's wives, one who causes miscarriage, one who violates the wife of his elders and superiors, a twice-born who drinks wine, one who uses excessively harsh words, one who opens up old hostilities, an atheist, one who speaks ill of the Vedas, one addicted to taking bribes, one whose holy thread ceremony has not been performed even through the time has come, one who secretly poisons cattle and one who injures a person who says "protect me”-all these are on the same level with those who slay Brahmanas.
verses.bhavadeepa: सत्कर्मद्वाराऽपि तस्य साधुत्वं न मन्तव्यमित्याह - मानेति । मानः लोकेषु उत्कर्षः तदर्थान्यग्निहोत्रादीनि भयदानीत्यर्थः मौनं ध्यानम् ॥४५॥

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पी च यश्च स्यात्पानपो द्विजः। अतितीक्ष्णश्च काकश्च नास्तिको वेदनिन्दकः ॥४७॥
verses.bhavadeepa: कुण्डाशी भगभक्षः । जीवति भर्तरि जाराज्जातः कुण्डस्तेन निमित्तेनाशितुं शीलः सोमविक्रयी प्रसिद्धः । पर्वकारः शरकृत् आयुधमात्रकर्तेत्यर्थः । सूची सूचको नक्षत्रादीनां परदोषाणां च ज्यौतिषिकः पिशुनो वा ॥४६॥

verses.sanskrit: स्रुवप्रग्रहणो व्रात्यः कीनाशश्चात्मवानपि। रक्षेत्युक्तश्च यो हिंस्यात् सर्वे ब्रह्महभिः समाः ॥४८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: काकः काकवत् क्षतोद्वर्तनेन दुःखितस्यापि दुःखप्रदः नास्तिकः परलोकादिद्वेषी ॥४७॥

verses.sanskrit: तृणोल्कया ज्ञायते जातरूपं वृत्तेन भद्रो व्यवहारेण साधुः। शूरो भयेष्वर्थकृच्छ्रेषु धीरः कृच्छ्रेष्वापत्सु सुहृदश्चारयश्च ॥४९॥
verses.english: Gold is known by fire, one of good birth by his behaviour, an honest man by his conduct, a hero in times of panic, a patient man during the time of poverty and friends and enemies during the seasons of difficulties and dangers.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्रुवप्रग्रहणः राजकीयवृत्तिबलेन सर्वेभ्यो वणिग्भ्यः स्रुवेण धान्यादिकमादत्ते ‘खोंचीग्राहक’ इति भाषायां प्रसिद्धः ।  ग्रामपुरोहित इत्यन्ये । व्रात्यः अतीतोपनयनकालः पतितसावित्रीको वा । कीनाशः कर्षकः आत्मवान् समर्थोऽपि यो रक्षेत्युक्तो हिंस्यात् एतेष्वाद्यं द्वयं त्वत्पुत्रेषु दृष्टम् ॥४८॥

verses.sanskrit: जरा रूपं हरति हि धैर्यमाशा मृत्युः प्राणान् धर्मचर्यामसूया। क्रोधः श्रियं शीलमनार्यसेवा ह्रियं कामः सर्वमेवाभिमानः ॥५०॥
verses.english: Old age destroys beauty; patience hope; death, life envy, virtue; passion, prosperity; association with the vulgar good manners; lust, modesty; and vanity, everything.
verses.bhavadeepa: तृणोल्कया तृणज्वालया जातरूपं रूपवद्वस्तु ज्ञायतेऽन्धकारे सति भद्रो वृषः धर्म इति । यावत् वृत्तेन शीलेन सोऽस्ति नास्तीति ज्ञायते व्यवहारेण अहिंसादिप्रधानेन कृच्छ्रेषु दुर्भिक्षादिसङ्कटेषु । त्वत्पुत्रेषु धर्मः साधुत्वं च नास्तीत्यर्थः ॥४९॥

verses.sanskrit: श्रीर्मङ्गलात् प्रभवति प्रागल्भ्यात् संप्रवर्धते। दाक्ष्यात्तु कुरुते मूलं संयमात् प्रतितिष्ठति ॥५१॥
verses.english: Prosperity has for its source good deeds; it increases owing to activity and takes root owing to skill and continues its existence owing to self-control.
verses.bhavadeepa: जरेति । त्वत्पुत्रेऽभिमानदोषोऽस्ति ॥५०॥

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ गुणाः पुरुषं दीपयन्ति प्रज्ञा च कौल्यं च दमः श्रुतं च। पराक्रमश्चाबहुभाषिता च दानं यथाशक्ति कृतज्ञता च ॥५२॥
verses.english: Eight qualities shed lustre on a man, viz., wisdom, noble blood, Self-restraint, burning prowess, moderation of speech charity to the best of one's own power and gratitude.
verses.bhavadeepa: श्रीरिति । दाक्ष्यं शीघ्रकारित्वं त्वयि संयमाभावान्न श्रीः स्थास्यति ॥५१॥

verses.sanskrit: एतान् गुणांस्तात महानुभावा नेको गुणः संश्रयते प्रसह्य। राजा यदा सत्कुरुते मनुष्यं सर्वान् गुणानेष गुणो विभाति ॥५३॥
verses.english: But, O dear, one thing alone can make all these great qualities come together. When a king honours a man, all the qualities shed luster on him.
verses.bhavadeepa: अष्टाविति । राज्ञा पुरस्कृतं पुरुषं प्रज्ञादयो हठादनुसरन्तीति श्लोकद्वयार्थः ॥५२॥

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ नृपेमानि मनुष्यलोके स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य निदर्शनानि। चत्वार्येषामन्ववेतानि सद्भिश्चत्वारि चैषामनुयान्ति सन्तः ॥५४॥
verses.english: These eight, O king, in this world of human beings are considered as the marks of heaven. Of these, four are the attributes of the good; and the honest men follow the other four.
verses.bhavadeepa: एष गुणो राजसत्कारः विभाति भासयति कर्णादिषु सत्कृतेषु आगन्तुका एते गुणाः सन्ति न स्वाभाविकाः अतस्ते नोपयोक्ष्यन्त इति भावः ॥५३॥

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञो दानमध्ययनं तपश्च चत्वार्येतान्यन्ववेतानि सद्भिः। दमः सत्यमार्जवमानृशंस्यं चत्वार्येतान्यनुयान्ति सन्तः ॥५५॥
verses.english: Sacrificial ceremonies, gifts, study and devotion, these tour are followed by the good. Self-control, truth, kindness and humanity, these four are also the attributes of the good.
verses.bhavadeepa: इमानि वक्ष्यमाणानि अन्ववेतानि नित्यसम्बद्धानि अनुयान्ति यत्नेन भजन्ति ॥५४॥

verses.sanskrit: इज्याध्ययनदनानि तपः सत्यं क्षमा घृणा। अलोभ इति मार्गोऽयं धर्मस्याष्टविधः स्मृतः॥५६॥
verses.english: Sacrificial ceremonies, study, gift, devotion, truth, forgiveness, mercy and contentment, these are the eight ways to virtue, according to the Smriti.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पूर्वचतुर्वर्गो दम्भार्थमपि सेव्यते। उत्तरश्च चतुर्वर्गो नामहात्मसु तिष्ठति॥५७॥
verses.english: The first four of these may be followed from motives of vanity; but the last four do not exist in those that are not great.

verses.sanskrit: न सा सभा यत्र न सन्ति वृद्धा न ते वृद्धा ये न वदन्ति धर्मम्। नासौ धर्मो यत्र न सत्यमस्ति न तत् सत्यं यच्छलेनाभ्युपेतम् ॥५८॥
verses.english: That one is not an assembly where there are no old men. Those are not old men who do not speak of virtue. That is not virtue where truth does not exist; and that is not truth where deceit pervades.
verses.bhavadeepa: तत्रेति । असत्यपि दमादौ दम्भार्थं यज्ञादिसंभवात् ॥५७॥

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं रूपं श्रुतं विद्या कौल्यं शीलं बलं धनम्। शौर्यं च चित्रभाष्यं च दशेमे स्वर्गयोनयः ॥५९॥
verses.english: Truth, beauty, learning, knowledge, good birth, good manners, strength, wealth, heroism and ability to talk on diverse topics, these ten have their origin in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पापं कुर्वन् पापकीर्तिः पापमेवाश्नुते फलम्। पुण्यं कुर्वन् पुण्यकीर्तिः पुण्यमत्यन्तमश्नुते ॥६०॥
verses.english: A man, who is notoriously sinful by doing sinful acts, gets evil fruits; and one, who is reputed to be virtuous by doing virtuous acts, gains great happiness.
verses.bhavadeepa: रूपं विनयमुद्रा श्रुतमध्ययनं विद्यादेवताद्युपासनं चित्रभाष्यं युक्तियुक्तं वचनं दशसंसर्गजा गुणा इति पाठे तद्युक्तैः सह सङ्गे कृते एते जायते तेन सत्सङ्गः कर्तव्य इति भावः ॥५९॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् पापं न कुर्वीत पुरुषः शंसितव्रतः। पापं प्रज्ञां नाशयति क्रियमाणं पुनः पुनः॥६१॥
verses.english: There should a man firmly resolve not to do sinful acts. The sinful acts being committed again and again destroy wisdom.
verses.bhavadeepa: पापकीर्तिः कल‌ङ्कित्वेन प्रसिद्धः ॥६०॥

verses.sanskrit: नष्टप्रज्ञः पापमेव नित्यमारभते नरः। पुण्यं प्रज्ञां वर्धयति क्रियमाणं पुनः पुनः॥६२॥
verses.english: The man who has lost his wisdom constantly commits sin. The virtuous acts being done again and again increase wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धप्रज्ञः पुण्यमेव नित्यमारभते नरः। पुण्यं कुर्वन् पुण्यकीर्तिः पुण्यं स्थानं स्म गच्छति। तस्मात् पुण्यं निषेवेत पुरुषः सुसमाहितः॥६३॥
verses.english: An old man and wise always does virtuous acts. By doing virtuous acts he gains a good reputation and goes to a holy place (hereafter). Therefore should a man intently practice virtue.

verses.sanskrit: असूयको दन्दशूको निष्ठुरो वैरकृच्छठः। स कृच्छ्रं महदाप्नोति न चिरात् पापमाचरन् ॥६४॥
verses.english: A man that is envious, one that gravely injures another, one who is cruel, one who is always making enemies of others and one who is deceitful by committing sins, soon meets with grave difficulties.

verses.sanskrit: अनसूयः कृतप्रज्ञः शोभनान्याचरन् सदा। न कृच्छ्रं महदाप्नोति सर्वत्र च विरोचते ॥६५॥
verses.english: He that is not envious and he who is wise by always doing graceful acts, never meets with any grave difficulties; and shines with luster everywhere.
verses.bhavadeepa: दन्दशूको मर्मछेत्ता निष्ठुरः अप्रियवाक् नचिरात् शीघ्रम् ॥६४॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्ञामेवागमयति यः प्राज्ञेभ्यः स पण्डितः। प्राज्ञो ह्यवाप्य धर्मार्थौ शक्नोति सुखमेधितुम् ॥६६॥
verses.english: He that assimilates the wisdom of the wise is himself wise; and he who is wise by doing acts, both virtuous and conducive to worldly benefits, succeeds in gaining happiness.
verses.bhavadeepa: न कृच्छ्रं समस्तं पदं सुखवाची ॥६५॥

verses.sanskrit: दिवसेनैव तत्कुर्याद्येन रात्रौ सुखं वसेत्। अष्टमासेन तत्कुर्याद्येन वर्षाः सुखं वसेत् ॥६७॥
verses.english: That act should be done by one during the day, which will enable him to live in comfort during the night; and that should be done in eight months which will enable one to live in comfort throughout the year.
verses.bhavadeepa: आगमयति आनयति ॥६६॥

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे वयसि तत्कुर्याद्येन वृद्धः सुखं वसेत्। यावज्जीवेन तत्कुर्याद्येन प्रेत्य सुखं वसेत् ॥६८॥
verses.english: That act should be done during the early years of life, which will enable one to live in comfort during the old age. That act should be done in this life which will enable one to live in happiness after death.
verses.bhavadeepa: वर्षा इत्यत्यन्तसंयोगे द्वितीया ॥६७॥

verses.sanskrit: जीर्णमन्नं प्रशंसन्ति भार्यां च गतयौवनाम्। शूरं विगतसङ्ग्रामं गतपारं तपस्विनम् ॥६९॥
verses.english: People speak well of that food which has been digested. They speak well of the wife whose youth has passed away and of that hero who has come off victorious in the battle and of that ascetic who has gone over to the other side (of life).

verses.sanskrit: धनेनाधर्मलब्धेन यच्छिद्रमपिधीयते। असंवृतं तद्भवति ततोऽन्यदवदीर्यते ॥७०॥
verses.english: The hole, that one seeks to stop by wealth acquired by foul means, remains uncovered; and others come into existence in other places.
verses.bhavadeepa: गतपारं प्राप्ततत्त्वम् ॥६९॥

verses.sanskrit: गुरुरात्मवतां शास्ता शास्ता राजा दुरात्मनाम्। अथ प्रच्छन्नपापानां शास्ता वैवस्वतो यमः ॥७१॥
verses.english: The preceptor is the controller of those who have their souls under restraint; the king is the controller of those who have bad souls; and Yama, the son of Vivasvata, is the controller of those who sin in secret.
verses.bhavadeepa: परिपाकसुखं कर्म त्वत्पुत्रा न कुर्वन्ति अन्यायेन च सुखं लिप्सन्ति तत्तु विपरीतमेवेत्याह - धनेनेति ॥७०॥

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां च नदीनां च कुलानां च महात्मनाम्। प्रभवो नाधिगन्तव्यः स्त्रीणां दुश्चरितस्य च ॥७२॥
verses.english: The greatness of Rishis, of rivers, of the banks of rivers and of the noble-minded cannot be conceived, as also the wickedness of a woman.
verses.bhavadeepa: आत्मवतां जितचित्तानां प्रच्छन्नपापो दुर्योधनः ॥७१॥

verses.sanskrit: द्विजातिपूजाभिरतो दाता ज्ञातिषु चार्जवी। क्षत्रियः शीलभाग्राजंश्चिरं पालयते महीम् ॥७३॥
verses.english: One attached to the worship of the twiceborn, one that makes gifts, one who behaves generously towards his cousins and the Kshatriya of good manners, rules the earth forever.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रभवः माहात्म्यं ‘प्रभवो जन्ममूले स्याज्जन्महेतौ पराक्रमे’ इति मेदिनी । नाधिगन्तव्यः नाधिगन्तुं शक्योऽनन्तत्वात् ॥७२॥

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णपुष्पां पृथिवीं चिन्वन्ति पुरुषास्त्रयः। शूरश्च कृतविद्यश्च यश्च जानाति सेवितुम् ॥७४॥
verses.english: These three, viz., the brave, the wise and these who know how to protect others, plucks flowers of gold from the earth.
verses.bhavadeepa: ज्ञातिषु अनार्जवी दुर्योधनः ॥७३॥

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिश्रेष्ठानि कर्माणि बाहुमध्यानि भारत। तानि जङ्घाजघन्यानि भारप्रत्यवराणि च ॥७५॥
verses.english: Acts performed by means of the intellect are the best; those performed by the arms come next; O Bharata, those by the things are bad; while those performed by carrying loads are the worst.
verses.bhavadeepa: शूराः पाण्डवाः सर्वत्र सुवर्णभाज इति भावः ॥७४॥

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनेऽथ शकुनौ मूढे दुःशासने तथा। कर्णे चैश्वर्यमाधाय कथं त्वं भूतिमिच्छसि ॥७६॥
verses.english: Having entrusted your kingdom Duryodhana, Shakuni and the fool Dushasana and Karna, how can you hope for prosperity?
verses.bhavadeepa: बुद्धिरेव येषां फलसिद्धौ साधनं तानि बुद्धिश्रेष्ठानि प्रशस्ततमानि कर्माणि बाहुमध्यानि बाहुबलसाध्यानि मध्यानि । जङ्घेति गोपनीयत्वं लक्ष्यते तेन कपटसाध्यानि जघन्यानि नीचानि । येषां सिद्धौ स्वशिरसि भारः सङ्कटं पतति तानि नीचतराणि ॥७५॥

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैर्गुणैरुपेतास्तु पाण्डवा भरतर्षभ। पितृवत्त्वयि वर्तन्ते तेषु वर्तस्व पुत्रवत् ॥७७॥
verses.english: The Pandavas who are possessed of every virtue, O best among the race of Bharata, depend on you as their father. Do you also depends upon them as your sons. to
verses.bhavadeepa: तत्रान्त्यद्वयवन्तो दुर्योधनादय इति मत्वा प्राह - दुर्योधन इति ॥७६॥
